speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very rapid onset for a rash; given the new cough and recent start of arthritis treatment, is there any chance you have been taking a new medication like allopurinol or methotrexate recently? Also, does the rash involve your hands, feet, or face?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on the upper half of the back. I also have Concern over sudden onset, Recent cough, Unaware of exposure to new environmental stimuli, Mucositis.
